description: os-context's suite fields, added to the core by import (DEC-S10): what a case needs from the lab (requires), the shared checks a suite skips (sharedChecks), and the cluster and target every case runs against. Hand-over for D10: this file moves to os-context/test/e2e/schema/os-context.suite.json, and os-context's catalog lists it under suiteSchema.

sharedChecks.description: Step 3.3: which of the five shared checks (_lib/shared-checks.yml) this suite does not call, and why. A suite that imports the library calls every check it does not list here (E214).

requires.description: What this step needs from the lab. The lab runner skips the step, not the case, when the lab does not meet it (ST-DEC14); the other bindings accept it and do not evaluate it.

What a case needs from the lab it runs against (scenarios design ST-O8). On a suite it applies to every case; a case adds to it: a case value replaces a scalar, features are united. A lab that does not meet it makes the case Not applicable on the lab page and skipped by the runner, with the reason.

storage.description: The storage the lab was built with.

features.description: Plan features that must be on.

family.description: The lab's image family. A plan without one is windowsServer.

identity.description: The lab's identity mode. A plan without one is domain.

rollbackPoint.description: true: the lab holds at least one verified, restorable rollback point.
